EBB Table Service 0.1.78-rc

Selecting an Approver in Confirm Environment changes now focuses the Supervisor / approver PIN input automatically and requests the numeric keyboard. Confirm and save sits directly beside the PIN field, with Cancel remaining separate. Plain and Styled prompt appearance preferences are retained.

No new Odoo server update is required beyond the deployed POS-independent Environment approval support. In-place installation retains orders, production URLs and stored API keys.
